measurement_scope: Isolated expression runtime. Input construction, warm-up, and manual expected checksums precede timing. prepare_execute includes Program compilation and State replacement, not SQL parsing/binding.
retention_scope: Process heap delta after State.Close and GC relative to the warmed fixture/program baseline; negative values include released State/container objects. Not proof of a per-query live-heap improvement.
decision: Direct. Bytecode violates analytical geometric-mean and per-workload thresholds; remove bytecode dispatch.
